Meta.Description: A weapon modification rumored to have been crafted by the Mechanic himself. Created entirely with his bare hands, without the use of any tools
Meta.Explanation: Weapon variant with reduced recoil, improved ergonomics, and decreased heat buildup, offering no drawbacks

Lapua.Description: A highly requested weapon variant, crafted for all you devoted Lapua enthusiasts
Lapua.Explanation: Weapon variant chambered with .338 Lapua Magnum caliber and compatible with all .338 magazines but with increased recoil and heat buildup

Overclocked & Automatic.Description: What happens when you put a processor in a weapon? It becomes automatic and requires cooling. And if you're adding cooling, why not overclock it to fire faster? Researchers remain deeply unsettled by this abomination
Overclocked & Automatic.Explanation: Weapon variant with a full-auto fire mode only, featuring an increased fire rate and improved cooling capabilities, but reduced ergonomics

Heavy Machine Gun.Description: Close your eyes and pull the trigger. Feel nothing. Become one with the gun
Heavy Machine Gun.Explanation: A weapon variant with full-auto fire mode only, featuring lower vertical recoil, significantly higher horizontal recoil, and an increased fire rate

Anti-materiel rifle.Description: Using quantum physics—and perhaps a touch of black magic—this weapon variant fires rounds typically reserved for combating lightly armored vehicles
Anti-materiel rifle.Explanation: A weapon variant chambered in the 12.7x108mm caliber with a single small magazine, increased horizontal recoil, and only capable of Misfire malfunctions. Uses 12.7x108mm ammo, available from Skier LL1

Point & Click.Description: The entire interior has been replaced with cutting-edge, experimental electronics, transforming it into a precise and efficient tool. Although slightly fragile, it can deliver four rounds simultaneously to the same target with pinpoint accuracy
Point & Click.Explanation: Weapon variant with low recoil and dispersion, an exceptionally high fire rate, a 5-round burst fire mode, and immunity to malfunctions, but causing increased wear to the weapon's durability

Buckshot Launcher.Description:
"Point and Click Shotgun Adventure"
A cousin of the Fullburst variant - unleashing full power with a single pull of the trigger!
Buckshot Launcher.Explanation: Shotgun variant with a full-magazine-per-click fire mode and significantly reduced recoil

Pay to Win.Description: Only for Tarkov whales! These guns literally shoot money!
Pay to Win.Explanation: Weapon variant chambered in .338 Lapua Magnum rounds, with increased visible recoil and reduced fire rate. Features incredibly expensive magazines

The Unheard Edition.Description:
Some internet portal claimed these weapons were made by Nikita and placed in special paid crates shortly after the EFT 1.0 release
Or… it was just a bad dream?
The Unheard Edition.Explanation: Weapon variant chambered in 12.7x108mm rounds, with increased visible recoil. Features incredibly expensive magazines
